propositions: baseline_advanced_at was never read in production and caused pathological git delta churn by being written on every reconciler pass regardless of actual baseline value change
BindingStore.set_baseline now implements a write-when-changed guard that compares the new baseline to the stored baseline and returns early without writing if they are equal
consecutive reconciler passes over unchanged Jira state must produce byte-identical bindings.json and no new git commits

baseline field filtering, None preservation, and equality comparison are centralized in set_baseline so all callers (reconcile, seed_baselines_from_snapshot, apply_inbound_records) automatically receive the same guarded behavior
removal of baseline_advanced_at reduces packed git delta cost from 13.84 KiB/version to 2.33 KiB/version (16.8% of baseline, within the 25% acceptance threshold)
